# Enclii

> Open source DevOps platform for deploying, scaling, and operating containerized
> services with enterprise-grade security, GitOps automation, and zero vendor lock-in.
> Go backend + Next.js frontend + ArgoCD GitOps + Cloudflare Tunnel zero-trust ingress.

Enclii is MADFAM's production DevOps platform running on a 2-node k3s cluster on Hetzner +
Cloudflare. It dogfoods itself — the control plane runs on Enclii. Authentication
is handled by Janua SSO (OIDC/RS256 JWT). GitOps via ArgoCD App-of-Apps with
12 apps in `infra/argocd/apps/` (incl. 1 ApplicationSet for projects).

- [ArgoCD Config](./infra/argocd/): Root application + 12 app definitions (incl. network-policies, vault, posthog, backup)

## Integrations

- [Janua SSO](https://github.com/madfam-org/janua): auth.madfam.io — OIDC/RS256 JWT authentication
- [Dhanam](https://github.com/madfam-org/dhanam): dhan.am — managed by ArgoCD
- [Integration Docs](./docs/integrations/)

## Components

- [apps/switchyard-api/](./apps/switchyard-api/): Control plane API (Go/Gin, port 4200)
- [apps/switchyard-ui/](./apps/switchyard-ui/): Web dashboard (Next.js, port 4201)
- [apps/dispatch/](./apps/dispatch/): Admin platform (Next.js, port 4203) — 109 unit tests (auth, RBAC, Cloudflare API, components)
- [packages/cli/](./packages/cli/): CLI (`enclii` command, Go/Cobra)
- [packages/sdk-go/](./packages/sdk-go/): Go SDK — API client (`pkg/client/`) and type definitions (`pkg/types/`) — 30 unit tests
- [packages/shared-lib/](./packages/shared-lib/): Shared utilities (cn, formatDate, formatBytes) — 19 unit tests
- [packages/ui-components/](./packages/ui-components/): Shared UI components (Button, Badge, Dialog, Table, etc.) — 18 unit tests
- [apps/roundhouse/](./apps/roundhouse/): Build pipeline workers (Kaniko) — 21 unit tests (handlers, switchyard client)
- [apps/status/](./apps/status/): Status page (port 4204) — real-time health checks with retry logic + 24h historical timeline (PostgreSQL-backed, adaptive 5-60 min windows based on viewport) + dark/light theme toggle + uptime API + incident management + auto-incident detection (creates/resolves incidents from consecutive health check failures, `AUTO_INCIDENTS_ENABLED` env var) + clickable service links (separate `href` for user-facing URL vs health-check `url`) + auto-scaled response time bars with configurable thresholds (`RESPONSE_TIME_THRESHOLDS` env var) + HTTP status code badges + 129 unit tests + 31 E2E tests
